text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. The season had come 
where every Umamusume puts their growth on 
the line.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha, Ayabe-san! How do you plan to 
spend this summer?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us compete with all our might right 
here! My dearest rival!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Affection...? There's none of that. She's 
just a competitor.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I will get stronger. Strong enough that 
in the autumn... I will beat you, too. 
That's all."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fwehhh... Trainer-saaan. Sparks are flying 
between the two of them. It feels like 
they don't even notice me at all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I need to stay super quiet so I don't get 
in the way. Quietly, quietly...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Ayabe-san. As rivals from the 
same generation, I think you ought to be 
sharpening each other's skills.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Me, Ayabe-san, and... Doto—the three of 
us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, m-meee?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Don't lump us all together. Having Doto as 
a training partner is more than enough for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Ayabe-san!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I, I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm being acknowledged~ My very existence 
is being recognizedddd♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, what are you doing? Come, over here. 
Let us prepare for training at once!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hai-ee♪ Heh, heh, heh!
She happily wags her tail. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto, there's something by your feet... 
What kind of animal is that?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, an animal!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. Is that a doggy? No, 
could it be... a raccoon dog?

text_block_list.name: Tanuki
text_block_list.text: Whuff, whuff...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't know why, but it's wagging its 
tail at me~. Wah-wah-wah!

"I'm not entirely sure why, but it seems 
I've been taken a liking to. Let us make 
this a fulfilling summer. Together with 
two rivals, and a tanuki."
